caption:
The video captures the curved, padded interior of a cabin seen through a wide-angle lens, where many people in dark flight suits occupy the space. Ceiling panels and a bundled rope on the left wall stay fixed, so the motion belongs to the occupants. Several are already drifting between horizontal floating poses and crouched, grounded stances in the cabin.

In the right foreground, a reddish-haired woman lowers from a floating pose until her feet touch the floor, settling into a crouch while extending an arm forward across the cabin. Behind her, a blonde woman floats with one arm extended, descends to a crouched stance, then rises again into a floating pose. Along the right wall, a man remains crouched against the padded surface for some time before lifting into a tucked float.

In the center, a few occupants remain crouched or seated on the floor, one holding a phone, while at the far-right edge a seated observer becomes visible holding a white-and-red megaphone.
relations: A reddish-haired woman in the right foreground transitions from a floating pose to a floor crouch while extending one arm across the cabin.
A blonde woman behind her descends from a horizontal float to a crouched stance, then rises back into a floating pose.
A man along the right padded wall remains crouched against the surface before lifting into a tucked float.
Center occupants stay crouched or seated on the floor, while a far-right observer holding a megaphone becomes visible.
